case: A record's registry payload declaration is another record's, so the declared authority and the enforced schema disagree about which fields are required.
why: This is the measured defect, restored on one record: all fifteen WORK-1.1 records declared ContextManifest's fifteen payload fields as their own required_fields, so record-registry.json said ConsequenceDerivation need not carry declared_floor_ref, reached_class_ids or frozen_payload_digest. records.schema.json was right and nothing compared the two. The mutation puts ContextManifest's list back on ConsequenceDerivation alone.
expect_failure_contains: REGISTRY AND SCHEMA DISAGREE ABOUT WHICH PAYLOAD FIELDS ARE REQUIRED
